name: Hasekura Ritsuko
source:
Sexy bombshell English teacher. She is the Swimming club adviser.

A top-notch swimmer and a woman of many talents. Her confident demeanor makes her intimidating, but she has a friendly personality and easy to get along with.

Education comes first, and she is always concerned for her students. She compared the protagonist to his brother, which angered him and causes him to assault her.
